style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. An asymmetric off-centre composition showing a modular compute hardware bay. A heavily shielded, frosted polymer data conduit is visibly constricted, routing into an array of brushed metal processing modules resting on a matte drafting table. Flat muted palette with a single amber accent color highlighting the constricted pathway. Thin consistent line weight, recognisable rack modules and interlocking connectors with physical depth. One directional light throwing a crisp cast shadow, generous empty margin.
